You've been learning since childhood - red, blue, green, Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, apple, ball, cat, dog. But till today, you can't even talk in English. Here there are only English teaching videos, no ads. Download the English Seekho app and finally speak that English which was never taught in school.] Speaker B: तो इंस्टॉल बटन पे क्लिक करो और इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
